views.title: Isometric
criteria: Central hub with three distinct U-cradles visible
Cube-corner layout: cradles equally spaced in azimuth, each pitched ~35° down
Part not clipped; no merged/blocked sockets

views.title: Front (−Y)
criteria: Cradle(s) pitched ~35° down from horizontal (cube-corner splay, not flat)
M3 clearance hole through cradle side walls readable or clearly implied
Hub does not fill the U-pocket in front of the stop

views.title: Top (+Z)
criteria: Three cradles at 120° around hub (cube-corner top view)
U openings clear to the stop face (hub cylinder not plugging sockets)
Radial symmetry of the three arms is obvious

views.title: Right (+X)
criteria: Cradle on +X azimuth shows stop wall and pocket depth
Bolt hole ~7.5 mm from stop, through beam section / T-slot center
Beam channel open from stop outward (seat path clear)
